correctness.rationale: The projective-plane axioms give the three localized chain-group dimensions claimed in the package. The displayed degree-three chains reach every degree-two generator, and the degree-four images have unique boundary coordinates that make the fourth boundary injective over every field. Subtracting the two boundary ranks from the middle chain dimension gives the claimed local rank. An independent Fano-plane reconstruction produced chain dimensions 9, 24, and 11, boundary ranks 9 and 11, and homology dimension 4, exactly matching the order-two case.
risks: Only one localized bidegree and distinct same-side endpoints are covered.
